title: Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons
summary: A UN conference in New York adopted the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons on 7 July 2017, by 122 votes in favour, one against and one abstention. It opened for signature on 20 September 2017 and entered into force on 22 January 2021, after the 50th ratification.

uncertainty.note: Adoption 7 July 2017; entry into force 22 January 2021.

importance.justification: First legally binding international agreement to prohibit nuclear weapons comprehensively, though no nuclear-armed state joined.
